verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a native bulk export of traces or datasets to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS) or a data warehouse, nor any scheduled export or sink connector. The CLI can read runs and pipe raw JSON to stdout or a file. That is a user-assembled workaround, not a product export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
